transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess what finally made me come in is that... my eating has just been kind of all over the place lately. 

Some weeks I barely touch my dinner at all. And then... other nights, I'll just stand in the kitchen eating crackers and sweets after everyone else has gone to bed. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
During those nights when you are eating crackers and sweets, do you feel like you are unable to stop or that you cannot control how much you are eating?
Um... no, not really. I don't think it's like that. I just... I'm just eating. I could stop if I wanted to, I guess.
Outside of your eating habits, have you been feeling particularly low, sad, or uninterested in things you usually enjoy lately?

Um... I mean, I guess so. Sometimes. 

I go through these stretches where... I don't know, the house just feels kind of gray and heavy. I'll just sit at the kitchen table for a while, feeling... empty, I guess. Even though nothing terrible has actually happened that day. So... yeah. I suppose I do.
Have you experienced these stretches of feeling empty and low at any point in your life before this current period?

Um... yeah. I suppose so. 

If I look back at it... those gray, kind of guilty periods where I just lose interest in things... I guess they've added up to about seven months total. Something like that.
During those gray, empty stretches, have you noticed any changes in how well you are able to sleep?
Um... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed any difference with my sleep. It's just... normal, I guess.
During those times when you feel low and empty, have you noticed that you are moving or speaking much more slowly than usual, or perhaps feeling restless and unable to sit still?
Um... no. I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't think I move any differently. I just... sit there, mostly.
Have these periods of feeling low and empty been occurring nearly every day for at least the past two years?
No... no, I don't think so. Not every day. Just... off and on, I guess. Not for two years straight.
During those times when you feel empty and low, do you find yourself feeling excessively guilty or like you are a burden to others?

I suppose... yeah. Sometimes I just... I spend hours replaying small things. Like if I bought an expensive tube of pigment, or... snapped at my spouse. I just sit there and... it makes me feel like I’ve ruined the whole household because of it.
Looking back over your life, were there distinct periods where you felt this way, followed by times where you felt completely like yourself again, or has this been one long, continuous stretch?
Um... no, not continuous. Just... distinct times, I guess. If I had to add up all those gray, guilty periods where I lose interest in things... it's probably been about seven months in total.
During those gray, empty periods, have you noticed that you feel physically tired or lack the energy to go about your daily tasks?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I still do what I need to do around the house. I don't think I feel... physically tired, just normal, I guess.

You mentioned having these 'gray' periods off and on; would you say you have had at least two separate, distinct episodes of feeling this way, with a period of feeling like your normal self in between them?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't... I don't keep track of how many times it happens. Or what counts as normal in between. I'm just not sure.
Looking back, can you recall at least one specific time in the past where you felt this way, and then a clear period where you felt back to your normal self, before these feelings came back again?
I... I really can't say for sure. I just... I don't remember it clearly enough to say if there was a specific time like that. It all kind of blurs together.
When you have these 'gray' periods, do they typically last for at least two weeks at a time?

I don't know about two weeks at a time... I just know that if you add up all those gray times... the times I feel guilty and just don't care about anything... it's probably been about seven months total.
When you have these 'gray' periods, do they ever last for two weeks or longer at a time?
I... I really don't know. Like I said, I don't keep track of the days like that. I just know it adds up over time. I couldn't tell you if it's exactly two weeks straight.
If you think back to the longest time you felt that 'gray' way, did it ever go on for as long as two weeks without you feeling even a little bit like your normal self?

I... I don't know about two weeks straight. I just... I know that if you add up all those gray times, the times I feel guilty and just don't care about anything... it's probably been about seven months total. That's all I know.
When you have these 'gray' periods, would you say you feel that way for most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I guess so. When it gets like that... the house just feels gray and heavy. I'll just sit at the kitchen table feeling empty. Even if nothing bad actually happened that day. It just stays like that.

If you think back over the last few years, can you remember a time when you felt that 'gray' way for a while, then felt completely back to your normal self for a period, and then later felt that 'gray' way all over again?
I'm not really sure. It's... hard to remember exactly how I felt a few years ago. It all just kind of blends together. I don't really pay attention to it like that.
Looking at the period of feeling 'gray' and empty that you are experiencing right now, has it lasted for at least two weeks without any significant breaks?
I don't know... I guess maybe? I haven't really been keeping track of the days. It just feels like it's been going on for a while now.

During these current periods when you feel gray and empty, are you still able to carry out your usual daily responsibilities like work, household chores, or social activities, or do you find that you are unable to get these things done?

I guess I haven't been getting much done. I... I was supposed to be doing this facilitator training, and keeping up with some writing for a private blog, but I just fell behind. It's hard to get my thoughts organized to actually do any of it. And... things at home have been tense. My husband and I aren't really keeping up with our normal routines right now.

Looking back at the years before this current period, can you recall at least one distinct time in the past when you felt this same 'gray' and empty way, followed by a period where you felt like yourself again?
I... I think I said before, I just really don't remember. I don't look back at things that way. So... no, I can't really pick out a specific time for you.
